title: Tickets, and when things go wrong
label: ch:gu-tickets-and-when-things-go-wrong
canDo: I can buy a ticket and ask about the next train (āvtī ṭren kyāre che?), report a lost bag or a missed train (khovāī gaī, chūṭī gaī), make a complaint, and read and write ઝ in ઝડપી.

payoff.summary: Complete GU-R280-at-the-station: buy a ticket, and report a problem.
